name: antigravity
description: Use Google Antigravity CLI from inside Claude Code for reviews, adversarial second opinions, delegated coding tasks, task-list execution, and plan verification.

agy_bin.title: Antigravity CLI binary
agy_bin.description: Path or command name for Antigravity CLI. Usually agy or antigravity.

max_job_minutes.title: Max job runtime in minutes
max_job_minutes.description: Maximum runtime for delegated Antigravity jobs before the bridge cancels the process tree.

default_mode.title: Default Antigravity mode
default_mode.description: Default execution mode: readonly, suggest, or worktree. direct-edit is intentionally unsupported.

cli_template.title: Optional Antigravity non-interactive template
cli_template.description: Optional expert override, for example: run --prompt-file {prompt} --json. Leave blank unless doctor reports unsupported non-interactive mode.
